summary.headline: Astrological Treatises 55–70
summary.text: Catalog entries 55–70 cover the twelve places, travel, bodily rulers of the stars, parental death, foreign-land deaths, twins, planetary nature, application and separation, spear-bearing, stellar phases and stations, zodiacal activity, stellar mixtures and configurations, conjunctions, and Claudius Ptolemy’s Fruit. The page also notes cosmic effects of luminary syzygies and tables of ascensional degrees for zodiac signs in the third and fifth climates.
